title: Merge Royal 2048
seo_title: Merge Royal 2048 — Play Free 2048 Card Puzzle Game Online
meta_desc: Play Merge Royal 2048 free online. Combine matching cards solitaire-style and merge your way to 2048 in this free browser number puzzle.
desc: Merge Royal 2048 fuses solitaire strategy with 2048 merging. Drag cards between stacks, combine matching values, and chain your way up to 2048.
howto: Drag cards from one stack to another with the mouse.
Merge cards holding the same value.
Each merge doubles the card's value.
Plan stacks so merges chain into each other.
tips: Keep one stack for low cards you cannot use yet.
Chain merges: set up 2-4-8 sequences before you commit.
Never bury a high card under an unmergeable one.
